decisions.reason: Despite weaker recent visibility, this multi-model box trailer series sits in the firm's core business and carries enough sunk development and prior public commitment that management would likely continue it rather than admit failure now.

The car transporter line is a specialized but still core transport product, so management would tend to attribute any disappointing results to temporary market factors and keep supporting it after the investment already made.

As a prominently launched low-bed trailer series closely tied to the firm's main capabilities, it remains hard to withdraw because of accumulated commitment and its fit with the firm's announced growth path.

This cover series is somewhat more peripheral than a full trailer line, but it complements the core trailer portfolio and prior visible commitment still makes continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Although portfolio overlap could invite later rationalization, this box trailer series is central to the firm's offering and the earlier investment and exposure create a strong bias to keep it on the market.
